en-US.description: Upload one product image and multiple scene references, then generate AI commercial product shots by integrating the product into each real scene one by one.
en-US.empty.sceneImages: Upload at least 1 scene image first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimitTooLow: The current model cannot use the product image and scene image together as references
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.generationMode.advanced.desc: Enhance material details, edge blending, spatial realism, and premium campaign quality.
en-US.generationMode.standard.desc: Balance generation efficiency with realistic commercial scene composition.
en-US.label: Product Scene Composite
en-US.upload.productImage.help: Upload one clear product image with a stable angle and clean background so the product subject can be identified accurately.
en-US.upload.sceneImages.help: Upload multiple real-scene references. The plugin will process them one by one, and each generation uses exactly 1 product image plus 1 scene image.

zh-CN.description: 上传单张商品图和多张场景参考图，将商品逐张融入真实场景，一键生成 AI 商拍图。
zh-CN.empty.productImage: 请先上传 1 张商品图
zh-CN.empty.sceneImages: 请先上传至少 1 张场景图
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimitTooLow: 当前模型不支持同时使用商品图和场景图作为参考图
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.generationMode.advanced.desc: 增强材质细节、边缘融合、空间真实感与商业成片质感。
zh-CN.generationMode.standard.desc: 平衡生成效率与真实场景商拍完成度。
zh-CN.label: 商品图合成
zh-CN.upload.productImage.help: 支持上传单张商品图，建议主体清晰、角度稳定、背景干净，便于准确识别商品主体。
zh-CN.upload.sceneImages.help: 支持上传多张真实场景图，生成时会逐张参考并分别输出。每次生成固定使用 1 张商品图 + 1 张场景图。
